card.chooseOther: Choose another clone for this picture

askText: Please draw a few profile pictures of yourself and show them to me, so I can choose one.
askTextStyled: Please draw a few profile pictures of yourself in the {style} style and show them to me, so I can choose one.

upload.wrongType: That file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture, so it was not used.
upload.tooLarge: That picture is larger than 10 MB, so it was not used. Choose a smaller one.

failure.unreachable: UClone-X could not be reached, so {name}'s picture was not changed. Try again once it is running.
failure.noClone: {name} is not installed here any more, so its picture was not changed.
failure.refused: {name}'s picture could not be changed with that file. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture of 10 MB or less.
failure.tooLarge: That picture is larger than 10 MB, so {name}'s picture was not changed. Choose a smaller one.
failure.notSaved: {name} has not been saved in this workspace yet, so it cannot keep a picture. Save it from its settings first.
failure.noWorkspace: UClone-X has no workspace folder open, so {name}'s picture was not changed. Open a workspace and try again.
failure.outsideWorkspace: That picture is outside the workspace, so it was not given to {name}. Upload it from this computer instead.
failure.noFile: That picture is no longer in the workspace, so {name}'s picture was not changed.
failure.staleChange: {name}'s picture was changed again since then, so that change was not undone. Choose the picture you want from its profile menu.
failure.failed: Something went wrong, so {name}'s picture was not changed. Try again.
